phrased.note: The line where the riff does not play: two-bar cells against the two-step (kick on 0 and 10, snare on 4 and 12), notes of three sixteenths and longer, rests where the drums take the stage, a slide into a note where the cell says so. A note is [step over the two bars, length, scale degree over home, 's' to slide in]. A phrase of `phrase` cells, each `cellBars` long: the statement is rolled once per theme by weight, the answer and the turn per phrase. In the drops, mains and grooves the whole phrase; in a build only `build` on its last bar; in an outro `outro.bars` (the bar of the phrase each outro bar plays) every `outro.everyPhrases` phrases, resting its last `outro.restBars` bars.

statements.note: hold and push: home, home again on the second kick, a slide up a third and back
the lift: up to the fifth on the second kick, the third, back home
the octave answer: home, a slide to the octave and down
rolling dotted eighths: 3 + 3 + 4, the second bar opening out

turns.note: space: two notes, then the drums alone, back on a pickup from the fifth under
the drop-out: one hit, the drums alone, a late pickup
the long slide: a held note sliding up to the third and back over the bar line
the walk down to the turn: home, the seventh under, the sixth, a pickup home

provenance.round: the phrased line, 10-06 (hands-on, after DNB-7); a row since 10-07
provenance.reading: authored against the two-step, not mined
